name: Investment Return Calculator
description: This tool helps you calculate the potential returns on your investments based on initial amount, interest rate, and duration. Great for investors wanting to project their investment growth.
metaTitle: Investment Return Calculator | Free Online Tool
metaDescription: Estimate your investment returns instantly. Free tool, no signup required!

faqs.question: What inputs do I need?
faqs.answer: Enter your initial investment, expected annual return rate, and investment duration.

faqs.question: Can I see monthly returns?
faqs.answer: This calculator provides annual returns, but you can adjust your inputs for more frequent analysis.

faqs.question: What is compound interest?
faqs.answer: Compound interest is the interest on your investment that accumulates over time, increasing your total returns.

variants.metaDescription: Estimate returns specifically for real estate investments.
variants.headline: Calculate potential returns on your real estate investments.

variants.metaDescription: Estimate returns on stock market investments.
variants.headline: Project your returns from stock market investments.
